description.value: The Dutch Wooden Shoe Cafe is a breakfast and brunch restaurant on Cambie Street in Vancouver specializing in Dutch-inspired dishes including traditional pannekoeks, Eggs Bene-Dutch on Dutch rusks with Edam cheese and Hollandaise, and Dutch recipe waffles. The menu also reflects the Dutch-Indonesian colonial culinary tradition with dishes like Nasi Goreng and Bahmi Goreng served with shrimp chips. Gluten-free pannekoek options are available on request, and the menu offers broad variety from hearty meat platters to vegetable-forward options.
